topic: LGBTQ+ & Allies Panel: Navigating Your Next Steps as an LGBTQ+ Undergraduate
title: LGBTQ+ & Allies Panel: Navigating Your Next Steps as an LGBTQ+ Undergraduate
session_title: LGBTQ+ & Allies Panel: Navigating Your Next Steps as an LGBTQ+ Undergraduate
abstract: Undergraduates have a lot of questions for what comes next in their careers. Whether it be graduate school, industry, or another path, there is a lot to learn and navigate. These anxieties can be multiplied for LGBTQ+ undergraduates. This panel session will have recruiters and young graduates giving advice and best practices for navigating recruiting and getting started for whatever comes next.
presenting_author: Bryan Deschamps | AIChE, New York, NY
